editorial: Imagine waking up to reality as written on a page you never expected to own. In this cyberpunk fantasy, Kim Dok-ja's ordinary life becomes the only roadmap to survival, granting him control over a world that literally bends to his knowledge. The film's kinetic opening sequence, where the protagonist's thoughts manifest as holographic bullet lists, keeps you guessing what comes next. If you crave a mashup of brain‑bending strategy and relentless action, you’ll find this narrative igniting your adrenaline.
targetAudience: Ideal for viewers craving cerebral sci-fi that blends action with intricate mind games.
